content.short: We are the fear of governments that lie in the name of truth. The alien invasion has begun.
content.description: We are the fear of governments that lie in the name of truth. The dread of power centers that threaten total destruction. We are the technology they can never build. Those who, for centuries, have watched them with pity for their slow progress. We are the observers of their miseries, those wrapped in the ambition for power and money. We are the ancient fear lurking in every corner of the Empire, and we are delighted... delighted!
